ceiling.formula: the speed of the linear plant at rest under a constant command at the limit, body leaning: the tilt's and the wheels' accelerations of loop.continuous set to 0 with the tilt rate 0 (A[1,0]*tilt + A[1,3]*v = -B[1]*u, A[3,0]*tilt + A[3,3]*v = -B[3]*u)

fell.by_ceiling_meaning: the points that fell, by whether the plant's ground-speed ceiling at the command limit is below the demanded speed (the demand is beyond the motor) or not (the law, or the plant's other parts, is the reason)

settled.meaning: mean of the hold window's second half less its first half

specs.name: linear_steady_speed
specs.reason: the linear model's answer, not criterion 17's or 18's verdict; the command limit was reached at 0 of 0 corners that did not fall; fails at the nominal values and at every corner

sensitivity.meaning: the batch run a second time with the perturbation added to every point's initial tilt rate; what changed is told, judged by nothing; a point whose verdict against the row's bound differs between the two runs counts neither as passing nor as failing
